baseline: 0.33.7 renderer with the same opt-in throughput fixture added before production renderer changes

host.gpu: Mesa software OpenGL (llvmpipe); native GPUI uses software Vulkan

method.frames: Six warmed camera-motion frames, including GPU completion/readback and BGRA conversion. Not hardware-GPU qualification or UI presentation FPS. Shadows/grid disabled in throughput samples. Draw submission elapsed can include driver waits.
method.synthetic: Generated 100x100-cell shared mesh, 50 placements, one million triangles and 20,000 boundary segments; no external fixture required.
method.drawing: User-provided demo.octd from an immutable private copy; drawing not published. 12,520 edges/17,060 triangles; 440 semantic/object placements. Selection probe passes 29,580 raw targets to the renderer.
method.native: Physical Move/Rotate inputs on 88 logical targets, 2,504 edges/3,412 triangles; canonical records and all nine selected object transforms checked for phantom non-mutation, commit, Undo, Redo and Escape.

sharing.notes: Group count is not VBO count; each group can have face/index/line/instance buffers and chunks. Upload counters are cumulative; the dense fixture reused a renderer after other regression cases.

checks.explicitBreakdown: Five OpenGL checks/probes and one dense marquee CPU probe
checks.wasm: Passed with three pre-existing browser dead-code warnings

limits: CPU world-space display metadata and its initial preparation still remain.
No frustum culling, display LOD, complete CPU scene-delta update or shadow atlas is claimed.
Transparent geometry uses an opaque-first blend pass; general order-independent transparency is not implemented.
Windows/macOS/physical GPU runs were not performed.
